page.layout: One column of running text, with a heading above it (running head and page number at top). A marginal reference "Luc.14." stands in the left margin beside the second paragraph. A new sermon heading "CONCIO LI." with its reference "1. Corinth. 7." is set below the text, followed by a paragraph with a large woodcut initial.

main_text.p: Secundum alios illi, qui vxores neglectim habet, perinde quasi eas statim essent amissuri vel, qui non ponunt in re vxoria summam felicitatem, adeo vt Dei obliuiscantur, & abiiciant curam æternæ salutis: sed sciunt hæc quoque rem, vt alias, non esse perpetuam, sed temporaneam, & vna cum habitu mundi præterire.

Deniq; illi qui vxorores suas non amant supra Christum, neque sinunt se ab illis in profesione euangelij impediri, propter quod etiam parati sunt illas, iuxta Christi regulá, Luc.14. odisse, ac relinquere, si opus sit. Vt vero & nos velimus ac valeamus Christi causa & euangelij, relinquere non solum vxores & liberos, sed etiam parentes, fratres, sorores, domos, aut agros & omnia, quo tandem etiam vitæ æternæ cum Apostolis electis ac sanctis (Matthæi 19. ) sortiamur hæreditatem, largiatur nobis Deus pater spiritum sanctum per Christum Iesum Dominum nostrum, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO LI.
1. Corinth. 7.

p.i: XOR alligata est matrimonio, quamdiu viuit maritus eius: quòd si dormierit maritus illius, libera est ad cui velit nubere, modò in Domino. Attamen beatior est, si sic maneat, iuxta meam sen-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "vxorores" as printed; "benaū" at the line end is unclear and marked [?] in the text where it stands was not added, since the word cannot be read with certainty; "fortiamur" is printed with a long s that looks like f, read as sortiamur (sortiri, to obtain by lot), not certain. "Attamen" is preceded by a small brace-like mark in the scan, not transcribed. Bottom of the page carries no catchword or signature. Running head read as printed.
